name: modlens
title_zh: 给纯文本模型装上能看图的插件式视觉
tagline_zh: 模型只认文字，却收到 .png/.jpg/.webp 路径？别自建 OCR、别硬调 PIL——一条硬规则。
tagline_en: Text-only model meets an image path? No DIY OCR, no PIL—one hard rule makes it auto-invoke vision wherever the.
desc_en: Plug-in vision for text-only models. Hard rule: when a file path or URL with an image extension (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp, .gif, .heic, .heif) appears anywhere in the conversation (typed by the user, injected as a `[Image: source: <path>]` line, or inside a tag) and you cannot see that image's content, run this skill on it before any other approach: no self-built OCR, no PIL, no tesseract. Also tr
why_zh: 机制是硬规则而非建议：任何扩展名图片出现即触发，且明确禁止自建 OCR/PIL/tesseract。
why_en: A hard rule, not a suggestion: any image extension triggers it, while self-built OCR/PIL/tesseract are explicitly banned—forcing.
limit_zh: 只处理图片文件路径或 URL，不认视频、PDF 或纯二进制流；且要求模型本身无视觉能力——若模型已能看图。
limit_en: Only image file paths/URLs; no video, PDF, or raw streams. Also inert if the model already has native vision—it won't trigger.
